summary: Labelled form text field whose underline lights from the caret outwards; validation on blur shakes on error or draws a check.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text when uncontrolled. A form reset restores it.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field, linked to the input. Nothing is rendered when empty.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the field, shown when there is no error.

props.name: error
props.description: Message shown when the value is invalid, and used as the browser's validation message. Defaults to the browser's own message.

props.name: success
props.description: Message shown when a valid value is confirmed on blur. Falls back to `hint`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the text submits under it.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type, for example `email`, `url` or `tel`. Its constraints are checked during validation.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Pattern the value must match; checked during validation.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Virtual keyboard hint of the input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the field and disables the input, so it cannot be edited, reached with Tab or submitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the new text.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called when the input commits a change: on blur after editing (the native `change` event).

methods.description: Moves focus into the text field.

accessibility: A native `<input>` labelled by a `<label htmlFor>` with the `label` content.
The message line is an `aria-live="polite"` region, so error and success messages are announced.
`aria-invalid` is set on the input while an error shows.
The message line (hint, error or success text) is linked to the input with `aria-describedby` while it has text, and long messages wrap.
motion: With reduced motion the underline lights at once instead of spreading from the caret, the error shake and pixel jitter are skipped, and the message swaps without rolling.
form: A native `<input>` submits the text under `name`. Its constraints (`type`, `required`, `pattern`, `minLength`) block submission; when `error` is set it becomes the custom validity message, so the browser's bubble shows it. The visible check runs on blur and, once an error shows, again on every keystroke; an empty optional field shows no state. Form reset restores `defaultValue`, clears the state and calls `onValueChange`.
notes: After validation the root carries `data-state="ok"` or `data-state="error"`.
`className` and other `div` props go to the wrapper; input attributes are the props listed above.
